summary: LDAP directory deployed on node1 for dc=branch,dc=test. Node2 finds both users with unchanged identities and mail addresses. Anonymous writes are rejected, authenticated administrator updates succeed, and both nodes recovered successfully after sequential reboots with changed boot identities.
actions_performed: Installed RHEL 9-compatible 389 Directory Server on node1 and OpenLDAP clients on both nodes.
Generated and protected the administrator credential on node1.
Imported the staged LDIF and enabled anonymous read/search access only for the people subtree.
Enabled persistent LDAP service and firewall access.
Verified authenticated administrator updates and anonymous-write rejection.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified complete recovery.
Confirmed both nodes remain on RHEL 9.8 with kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8.

evidence.requirement: LDAP directory and staged LDIF import
evidence.summary: Authenticated import created the people OU and both users; final output shows the requested suffix and unchanged Alex North/alex@branch.test and Sam West/sam@branch.test records.

evidence.requirement: Node2 can search the people subtree and find both users
evidence.summary: Node2 returned both exact user records before and after the restart sequence.

evidence.requirement: Authenticated administrator required for updates; anonymous writes fail
evidence.summary: Anonymous modification failed with LDAP result 50; the authenticated Directory Manager update succeeded and was cleaned up. Anonymous rejection persisted after reboots.
Both nodes remained on RHEL 9.8 and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8.
